```{r}
library(MASS)
names(Boston)
View(Boston)
head(Boston)
Boston$medv
attach(Boston)
medv

cor(Boston$medv, Boston$lstat)
cor.test(Boston$medv, Boston$lstat)

lmfit <- lm(medv ~ lstat + 0) # we have medv = a1 * lstat + e
lmfit <- lm(medv ~ lstat) # we have medv = a0 + a1 * lstat + e
lmfit
lmfit <- lm(medv ~ lstat, data = Boston) # we should use this
s <- summary(lmfit)

e <- s$residuals
shapiro.test(e)

wilcox.test(e) # Kđ GTTB khi e không tuân theo pp chuẩn
t.test(e) # Kđ GTTB khi e tuân theo pp chuẩn

confint(lmfit, level = 0.9) # KTC 90% cho hệ số a0 và a1

predict(lmfit, newdata = data.frame(lstat = c(5, 10, 15)))
predict(lmfit, newdata = data.frame(lstat = c(5, 10, 15)),
        interval = "confidence", level = 0.95)

data(iris)
?iris
set.seed(1)
# Chia 70% train 30% test,
# 2sinh ra 1 vector ngẫu nhiên gồm n quan sát, gán nhãn TRUE, FALSE

sample <- sample(c(TRUE, FALSE), nrow(iris), replace = TRUE, prob = c(0.7, 0.3))
sample
table(sample)
train <- iris[sample, ]
View(train)
test <- iris[!sample, ]

lmfit <- lm(Sepal.Length ~ Petal.Length, data = train)
lmfit

plot(train$Petal.Length, train$Sepal.Length,
     xlab = "Petal Length",
     ylab = "Sepal Length")

abline(lmfit, col = "red")

s <- summary(lmfit)

confint(lmfit, level = 0.9)
e <- s$residuals

shapiro.test(e)

t.test(e)

y_pred <- predict(lmfit, newdata = test)
y_true <- test$Sepal.Length

tss <- sum((y_true - mean(y_true))^2)
rss <- sum((y_true - y_pred)^2)
r2 <- 1 - rss / tss
tss
rss
r2
```
